'''Larsh Hill''' was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] financer and member of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. He was the Chief Operating Officer of [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] and one of the most trusted agents and a friend of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]], alter ego of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], and even earlier, of [[Caar Damask|Damask's father]]; the same role was played after his death by his son, the future [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] leader [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]].

==Biography==
Hill was well associated with Hego Damask, and was one of the first to meet him on [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]], after the injured [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] returned from [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] after killing his [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] Master, [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]]. Hill was one of Damask's trusted allies and accompanied Damask practically on any business venture. Hill accompanied Damask to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], for [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] to secure the plasma reserves with the aid of [[Bon Tapalo/Legends|Bon Tapalo]] and [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

In [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]], Hill was given the honor to join the [[Order of the Canted Circle]]&mdash;this honor, however, proved fatal, as his initiation ceremony was chosen by the [[Maladian]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] hired by [[Pax Teem]] for their [[Attack on the Lodge of the Canted Circle|attack]] on Damask. In the [[Fobosi District/Legends|Fobosi District]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]], Hill, in the presence of Damask and the members of the Canted Circle, genuflected in front of a disguised Maladian assassin. A pendant was brought in a swinging motion to Hill's neck, which decapitated him immediately, and his head rolled a few meters away from his body as one after another of his hearts failed.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|And just so you know, Hego, your father would be proud.|Larsh Hill to Hego Damask|<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />}}
Hill was a fatherly figure towards Hego Damask. He often showed concern towards the young Muun, but was occasionally exasperated by him. Hill valued business, but he sometimes displayed grudges with business partners, such as the [[Tonith family]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
